title: Intelligence engineering
summary: Build useful intelligence. Know what makes it work.
detail: Follow the request from a web API through data, retrieval, generation and tools. Each boundary needs an explicit contract and evidence that the system behaves as intended. Select components to create a working evaluation plan.
failures: A polished demo without representative evidence

title: API & gateway
summary: Start at the interface your application exposes.
detail: A gateway routes and governs calls. The application still owns task semantics, authorization, deadlines and the response contract. Keep model inference APIs, agent-facing tool gateways and application APIs distinct.

title: Request & response contract
summary: Decide what a successful response actually means.
detail: Validate inputs, return stable error types and test authorization independently of model behavior. A valid JSON response establishes shape. It does not establish factual correctness.
failures: Missing values coerced into empty strings
Model text treated as trusted code

title: Model routing & budgets
summary: Choose where a request runs and what it may consume.
detail: Record provider, model, prompt and retrieval versions for each evaluated configuration. Test fallback routes on the same tasks. A fallback may differ in tool support, safety behavior, quality and data location.
failures: Data sent to an unapproved region
